import sys

MAX = 31
P = 10**9 + 7

n = 0
matrix = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]

class Mat:
    def __init__(self):
        self.t = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    
    def setIdentity(self):
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                self.t[i][j] = 1 if i == j else 0
    
    def multiply(self, b):
        global matrix
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                matrix[i][j] = 0
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(n):
                    matrix[i][k] += self.t[i][j] * b.t[j][k]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                self.t[i][j] = matrix[i][j] % P

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    m_in = int(input_data[0])
    k_in = int(input_data[1])
    m = m_in
    k = k_in

    digitsVec = []
    while m:
        digitsVec.append(m % k)
        m //=k

    global n
    n = k + 1

    baseMat = Mat()
    baseMat.t = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(k):
        baseMat.t[i][(i+1)%k] = 1
    baseMat.t[k][k] = 1

    idMat = Mat()
    idMat.setIdentity()

    for i in range(k+1):
        baseMat.t[0][i] = 1
        baseMat.t[i][i] = 1

    dMat = [Mat() for _ in range(len(digitsVec))]
    dMat[0] = idMat
    dMat[0].multiply(baseMat)

    for i in range(1, len(digitsVec)):
        dMat[i] = dMat[i-1]
        for _ in range(k):
            dMat[i].multiply(dMat[i])
        dMat[i].multiply(baseMat)

    answer = [1] * n

    for idx in range(len(digitsVec)-1, -1, -1):
        for _ in range(digitsVec[idx]):
            powerArr = [0]*n
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    powerArr[j] += answer[i] * dMat[idx].t[i][j]
            for i in range(n):
                answer[i] = powerArr[i] % P

    print(answer[k])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
